name: 95126 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95126 (San Jose) has 188 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95126 (San Jose) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95126 (San Jose) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
